categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction creation in src/wallet/spend.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents an integer overflow and assertion crash when funding transactions with recipient amounts exceeding MAX_MONEY. As shown in the description, funding out-of-range amounts via RPCs like fundrawtransaction could wrap recipients_sum, trigger an assertion failure in RecalculateWaste, or generate transactions exceeding 21 million BTC; while fixing a crash and undefined behavior is a clear reliability improvement, it is triggered only by nonsensical inputs and is reasonably deferrable.
